name: adidas Yeezy Slides 'Enflame Orange'
story_html: The adidas Yeezy Slide ‘Enflame Orange’ updates the minimalist slip-on with a deep citrus hue. The lightweight build, formed with injected EVA, features breathable open-toe construction and a plush footbed for soft landings. The latter is marked with adidas’ three-stripe logo, representing the only bit of exterior branding. Pronounced flex grooves distinguish the outsole, offering improved cushioning and durable traction.
